job.title: Staff Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders)

tailoring.headline: Staff Platform Engineer & E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud & Enterprise Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of scalable data and API integrations, production troubleshooting, and technical guidance in agile international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Staff Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders)
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of backend engineering expertise building scalable enterprise e-commerce platforms and cloud deployments at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Staff Platform Engineer position at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG. Your focus on high-throughput platforms and international collaboration closely aligns with my technical background.

bullets.label: Platform Reliability & Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and production troubleshooting on SAP Commerce Cloud platforms within agile DevOps workflows.

bullets.label: High-Throughput Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and optimized scalable data pipelines and RESTful microservices, ensuring system stability and high-performance transaction processing.

bullets.label: System Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and optimized backend components to reduce response latency and improve transaction speed under heavy load.

bullets.label: Technical Mentorship
bullets.text: Conducted code reviews, guided junior developers, and collaborated directly with international technical teams to drive software delivery best practices.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my engineering experience adds value to your platform team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Staff Platform Engineer - Cloud Platform (all genders)
cover_de.hook: Mit über fünf Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung hochverfügbarer Enterprise-Plattformen bei Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell möchte ich gerne zum Erfolg von SCAYLE und ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG beitragen. Ihr Fokus auf skalierbare Architekturen und technologische Exzellenz passt perfekt zu meinem Profil.

bullets.label: Plattformbetrieb & CI/CD
bullets.text: Durchführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen, Release-Builds und Fehlerbehebung in Cloud-Umgebungen im Rahmen agiler DevOps-Prozesse.

bullets.label: Skalierbarkeit & Performance
bullets.text: Entwicklung robuster Microservices und REST-APIs sowie Optimierung von Daten-Pipelines für performante Transaktionsabläufe.

bullets.label: System-Optimierung
bullets.text: Durchführung von Datenbank-Query-Refactoring zur Reduzierung von Latenzen und Verbesserung der Systemstabilität unter Last.

bullets.label: Mentoring & Teamarbeit
bullets.text: Technische Anleitung von Junior-Entwicklern, Durchführung von Code-Reviews und enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine unbefristete Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 (frühester Start 16.12.2026). Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: ABOUT YOU and SCAYLE build exceptionally fast-growing enterprise commerce platforms operating at massive scale. I want to contribute my backend and platform engineering experience from Shell and Rockwell Automation to help maintain resilient, high-throughput systems while collaborating within an international engineering culture.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise backend and platform delivery experience to support scalable, high-availability commerce infrastructure.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise backend and cloud platform experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'm very interested in the Staff Platform Engineer role at ABOUT YOU. My last working day is 15.12.2026 (start 16.12.2026). Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Staff Platform Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Staff Platform Engineer position at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG. With over 5 years of backend development, cloud deployments, and system optimization experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in building resilient enterprise platforms.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026 with an earliest start date of 16.12.2026.

I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
